svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 08 · San Diego · 08/12 Black's Beach (Common)
svg.desc: A long walk down below the cliffs. The surfers are already out, waiting on the next set. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
